title: Changelog
intro: What have we been up to recently? Find out exactly whats changed in in each version below starting from the most recent changes.

changes.text: A getting started checklist now walks you through the three steps before your first lesson. It takes over the page while there is nothing on it yet, and reads differently for a tutor and a student since the two start from different places.

The checklist steps back to a card once a page has something of its own to show - beside the coming up next card on the dashboard, above the table on your tutors or students page - so each page makes room for its own content as soon as it has any. It disappears altogether once your first lesson has started.

Students who have not linked a tutor yet can now request a tutor account from the checklist. The form asks what you teach, roughly how many students you have and where you tutor now; your name, email and account are attached automatically.
The coming up next card now keeps its tags at the foot of the card and holds a minimum height, so it ends level with the checklist beside it rather than the pair finishing at different points.

The dashboard and your tutors or students page now wait for everything they have asked for before drawing, rather than filling in as each answer arrives. A step you had already completed could briefly show as outstanding while the rest of the page loaded.
The dashboard sidebar can now be collapsed to a strip of icons using the Collapse button at the foot of it. Hovering an icon names it while collapsed.
Whether the sidebar was left collapsed or expanded is now remembered between visits, and applied before the page is drawn so nothing shifts as it loads.

The dashboard now uses its full layout on tablets, with the sidebar, filters and workspace tables as they appear on a desktop, rather than the narrower phone version it showed before. Phone screens keep the layout they had.

The sidebar now starts collapsed to its icons on a tablet and expanded on wider screens, so a narrower window keeps more of its width for the workspace tables. Setting it with the Collapse button still overrides this at every screen size.

The next card now sizes itself against the room the sidebar leaves rather than always taking the same share of it. On a tablet it spans the full width, and on a smaller laptop it does the same while the sidebar is expanded, narrowing to half the row once the sidebar is collapsed. Wider screens are unchanged.
Workspaces can now be joined from a tablet, through the next card or a workspace's menu, rather than only from a desktop. Phones still cannot open a board.

The tabs, search and column headings above a workspace table now stay pinned to the top of the page as you scroll, so you can see which column you are reading and switch tab without scrolling back up. Only the page title and the next card scroll away.

Row height can now be set to compact, default or comfortable from the new button beside Clear filters, so you can fit more workspaces on screen or give each one more room. The setting is remembered between visits and applies to your connections as well.

The workspace and connections tables now give every column a minimum width and scroll sideways when there is not enough room for all of them, rather than squeezing each column into a fixed share of the width. Columns still share out any spare space on a wide screen.

A workspace's header, or a person's name on the connections page, now stays pinned to the left of its row while the table is scrolled sideways, and the row's menu stays pinned to the right, so a row can always be identified and acted on.

The [cookie policy](/cookie-policy) now covers the two cookies that remember the sidebar setting and the row height. Neither holds anything that identifies you, and each is only stored once you have used the control that sets it.
The navigation bar now uses a frosted background rather than fading into the page behind it, so it stays legible over whatever it covers, and sits closer to the edges on narrow screens.
Workspace creation and modification dialog would reset intermittently, this bug has been fixed.
Clear filters button styling updated for consistency between itself and other button states.
Students would see their tutor icon in the next card and their own icon in the workspace list, this bug has been fixed.
Increased workspace grace period when moving from upcoming to previous tabs from 5 minutes to 10 minutes.
Workspaces now open an hour before the lesson begins rather than from the moment they are created, so a board can only be joined around the session it was made for.

A workspace's start time is fixed once it has opened. Everything else stays editable, so feedback can still be written after the lesson; if a session is not going ahead, delete the workspace instead of moving it.
Workspaces are now removed 14 days after their start time rather than after 14 days without activity, so how long a board and its feedback are kept, is known the moment it is scheduled.

A status against every workspace showing where it is in that cycle - when it opens, that it is ready to join, or how long is left before it is deleted - counting down live without needing a page refresh.

Joining is now disabled, rather than failing on arrival, while a workspace is closed, and says why. A board opened directly outside its window explains whether it has not opened yet, has no start time, or has already been removed.

Warnings when scheduling a workspace that will not behave as expected: one with no start time cannot be opened and is deleted the same night, and one booked inside the opening hour opens straight away with its start time locked on save.
Changelog entries are now dated by the day a version went live rather than the day its code was written, so the dates line up with when the changes actually reached the app.
The loader for the search sessions input, within the dashboard, has been updated to match the styling of the loaded input.
The version you are running is now shown in the footer of the home page, beside the copyright, and is written with a v prefix everywhere it appears.

Erasing no longer makes a board re-count everything it has ever held each time something is rubbed out. This was by far the largest source of database work during a lesson, and a busy board now costs a small fraction of what it did.
The eraser sends its changes a little less often while it is being dragged. Rubbing out feels the same, but a long sweep across a full board is a fraction of the work it was.

A board now accepts at most three connections at once from the same person, so one account cannot hold a room open across a dozen tabs. A fourth tab waits instead of joining, and connects as soon as one of the others is closed.

Rejoining the same board over and over is now limited, since every join reloads the whole drawing. Ordinary use is unaffected and a few reloads in a row are fine, but a run of rapid reconnections is held back until it settles.
Users now get evicted from the workspace if they are removed by a tutor instead of their access persisting until their next page reload.
The nightly clean-up of inactive workspaces now works in batches within a time limit, so a large backlog is cleared over several nights rather than timing out.
Corrected inconsistencies between styling of the coming up next card's empty and loading states.
Deleting a workspace now fully releases its realtime storage. Previously every deleted board left an empty room behind that was never reclaimed.
Deleting a workspace while its board was still open could leave that room's storage behind. It is now cleared either way.

changes: Chalkie Chalkie's minimal-production release. This includes all basic features that the app will continue to develop and sets up the infrastructre to build upon.

changes.text: Migrated image storage from Supabase to Cloudflare R2.
Migrated realtime infrastructure from Liveblocks to Cloudflare workers & durable objects.
